note: A PekkaDex learning path written from the guides already in this repository. It is opinion, not official Supercell coaching, and it names no game numbers.

stages.title: Read the base before you cook
stages.goal: Decide which side of the base you can actually enter, before spending a single troop.
checks: Count the compartments: one ring, two rings, or a core box.
Find the Air Defences and Air Sweepers, and note which side they cover.
Find the Eagle Artillery, Monolith and Scattershot and mark the square they own.

stages.title: Build a funnel that holds
stages.goal: Make the outside ring walk inward instead of around, so the middle of the army stays together.
checks: Clear one collector cluster on each side of your entry.
Let the funnel troops finish before the main army lands.
Watch the corner: a builder hut or a lone camp is often the leak.

stages.title: Use a hero dive with a purpose
stages.goal: Send the Queen or Warden at a specific defence, not at whatever is closest.
checks: Name the target out loud: one Air Defence, the Eagle, or a compartment wall.
Have a way to pull the defending Clan Castle before the dive commits.
Keep a rage or freeze for the moment the dive meets splash damage.

stages.title: Time the spells, not the troops
stages.goal: Spells decide the middle of the attack; troop placement only decides the start.
checks: Rage the part of the army that is already winning.
Freeze the defence that is actually killing the push, not the first one you see.
Save one spell for the last core compartment rather than opening with everything.

stages.title: Plan the cleanup
stages.goal: Know what finishes the last 15 percent before the attack starts.
checks: Reserve fast troops or a hero for the outside ring.
Do not send every troop into the core and leave the corners alone.
Keep one ability in reserve for the last defence.

stages.title: Review the replay like a coach
stages.goal: Turn one failed attack into a rule you use next war.
checks: Find the exact second the funnel broke, not the moment the attack failed.
Write one sentence about what you will change next time.
Re-run the same base with one change, not five.
